files.finding: First deferred update generates synchronously; subsequent updates can be dispatched to worker pool. Output replacement emits changed; generated 2D mipmaps are configurable.

First deferred update generates synchronously; later updates can use workers. Texture creation disables mipmaps; has_mipmaps returns false. get_data logs an error and returns an empty vector on an invalid texture RID.
With particle animation enabled, one frame is selected by flooring INSTANCE_CUSTOM.z multiplied by frame count; coordinates select the resulting atlas cell.
